title: Lookup Workload Timestamps
description: Lookup first_occurrence and last_occurrence timestamps for a given workload using Cloud Logging. Automatically infers a narrow search window when the workload name contains a MMDD or YYYYMMDD date token (e.g., my-tpu-job-0827); for other runs older than 30 days, pass explicit --start/--end timestamps.

questionnaire.title: Analysis Lookback Window
questionnaire.description: Specify how many days back to analyze workload logs and telemetry (defaults to 1 day).

fields.name: lookback_days
fields.question: How far back should we analyze? (Specify how many days to look back; default is 1 day)

restart_attempt.description: JobSet restart attempt index (optional, default -1 to discover workload timestamps across all attempts in a single pass). When >= 0, filters timestamps specifically for this restart attempt.

latest_attempts.description: If > 0, discover distinct attempt numbers across the workload, sort descending, and return only the latest N attempts.

window_minutes.description: Trailing triage window duration in minutes prior to last_occurrence (default 5). Set <= 0 for full run window.

lookback_days.description: Number of days to look back from the current time (or end timestamp) when an explicit start timestamp is not provided (default: 1 day).

output_file.description: Path to write the structured JSON output.
